title: E-Commerce Migration for Summit Outdoor
description: Rebuilt a slow, legacy storefront on a modern platform with custom product filtering, cutting page load times by 60%.

content.body:
### Introduction

Summit Outdoor’s storefront was slow, hard to maintain and losing sales. We planned a phased move to a modern platform with zero downtime, keeping every search ranking through careful redirect mapping.

content.imageAlt: The new storefront on a desktop, laptop, tablet and phone

content.body:
### From legacy to modern

The migration covered more than 500 product pages. We:

1. audited every page and its traffic
2. mapped each old address to its new one
3. rebuilt the catalog with the filters customers actually use

Cart abandonment fell by 35% once checkout dropped from five steps to two.

### Working as one team

Weekly reviews with Summit’s merchandisers kept the catalog accurate while it moved.

content.body:
### The outcome

The move finished with zero downtime and no lost rankings. Pages load 60% faster, and the new filters help customers find the right gear in fewer clicks.
